# Communication workspace

**Status:** Draft structures plus one verified **2024 two-model development** figure. The [figure](development_two_model_2024.png) is generated by [its source script](build_development_chart.py) from the full 2024 development run and explicitly excludes native v2 and the 2025 evaluation. It is not a three-model result asset or launch graphic. The [carousel wireframe](carousel_wireframe.md) has no final result graphics. The [measurement log](launch_metrics.csv) has headers only and should be filled after an owner-authorized launch.

**Primary reader:** a BI or analytics engineer considering native SQL forecasting against a maintained custom pipeline. **Primary call to action for result assets:** inspect the public repository and evidence for the release run. Each asset should make one specific point and use one primary destination.

Use [10_POST_DRAFTS_ASSET_BRIEFS.md](../10_POST_DRAFTS_ASSET_BRIEFS.md) for conditional caption drafts. Before release, replace every placeholder with verified evidence, cite its claim ID, inspect charts at phone width, add alt text and captions, and have a reviewer check source rows. No post, message or repository publication is authorized by this folder.
